verses.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

segments.text: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

notes: 40.1 I waited…: Heb. In waiting I waited

verses.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

segments.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock,

notes: 40.2 an…: Heb. a pit of noise

verses.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

segments.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth,
praise unto our God: many shall see
, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

verses.text: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

segments.text: that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.text: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

segments.text: thou hast done, and thy thoughts
to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee:
, they are more than can be numbered.

notes: 40.5 they cannot…: or, none can order them unto thee

verses.text: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

segments.text: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

segments.text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book

verses.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

segments.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law

notes: 40.8 within…: Heb. in the midst of my bowels

verses.text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

segments.text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

verses.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

segments.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

segments.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

segments.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

segments.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

verses.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

segments.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

segments.text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

segments.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

verses.text: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

segments.text: the Lord thinketh upon me: thou
my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
